requirements.description: User prefers the unit to be near parks. Per the 'near' rule, the threshold is set at the 75th percentile of the green distribution (74.26), rounded to 74.
The user requires the property to be in energy class D or better, which covers classes A1 through A4, B, C and D.

The user explicitly requires at least 115 sqm of gross floor area. Capacity for 15 people is not a surface requirement and was not converted to an area filter, since no verified gross-property-area threshold was supplied by the RegulatoryAgent. Energy class and proximity to parks are outside the reference columns and were not applied. The city 'Turin' was not mapped to comune_code, since it is a geographic place handled by the Location Agent.

output.explanation: Filters on the extracted requirements only: commercial property type, surface_area >= 115 sqm, within 3.0 km of (45.0677551, 7.6824892) via haversine on latitude/longitude, energy class D or better (A1-A4, B, C, D), and green score >= 74. Results are ordered by distance to the coordinates. No LIMIT applied.
